task_meta.title: Fix a job runner that retries failing jobs forever, without breaking its other retry rules

claim_text:
Fixed. `test_failing_job_is_eventually_dead_lettered` now passes, and so does the rest of the suite (7 tests).

**Why it retried forever:** the worker scheduled retries with `JobQueue.reschedule()`, and that function always set `attempts` back to 0. That reset is right when a per
digest: Read 4 files (4 before its first edit), made 0 edits, ran tests 2 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
